CHAPTER.CAPTION: To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David, to bring to remembrance.
CHAPTER.VERS: Make haste, O God, to rescue me; make haste to help me, O Jehovah.
Let them be ashamed and abashed, those who seek after my soul; let them be turned backward and dishonored, those who desire my hurt.
Let them be turned back as a consequence of their shame, those who say, Aha, aha!
Let all those who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; and let those who love Your salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
But I am lowly and needy; make haste to me, O God! You are my help and my deliverer; O Jehovah, do not delay!
